mozconfig:
ac_add_options --enable-application=browser
 
ac_add_options --allow-addon-sideload
ac_add_options --disable-crashreporter
ac_add_options --disable-backgroundtasks
ac_add_options --disable-debug
ac_add_options --disable-default-browser-agent
ac_add_options --disable-tests
ac_add_options --disable-updater
# ac_add_options --enable-hardening
# ac_add_options --enable-jxl
# ac_add_options --enable-optimize
ac_add_options --enable-release
# ac_add_options --enable-rust-simd

ac_add_options --disable-system-policies
# ac_add_options --disable-accessibility
# ac_add_options --disable-webspeech

ac_add_options --with-app-name=cloakfox
ac_add_options --with-branding=browser/branding/cloakfox

ac_add_options --with-unsigned-addon-scopes=app,system

ac_add_options --disable-bootstrap

export MOZ_REQUIRE_SIGNING=

mk_add_options MOZ_CRASHREPORTER=0
mk_add_options MOZ_DATA_REPORTING=0
mk_add_options MOZ_SERVICES_HEALTHREPORT=0
mk_add_options MOZ_TELEMETRY_REPORTING=0
mk_add_options MOZ_INSTALLER=0
mk_add_options MOZ_AUTOMATION_INSTALLER=0

# ac_add_options --enable-lto=cross

# sccache path set by CI via --with-ccache=$SCCACHE_PATH appended in workflow
# Don't add --with-ccache=sccache here — it triggers bootstrap to download its own sccache

# Cloakfox: bundle metric-compatible fonts (native MOZ_BUNDLED_FONTS,
# forced on for macOS where it is off by default) for cross-OS coherence.
ac_add_options --enable-bundled-fonts

# Native macOS arm64 port using installed Mozilla toolchain.
ac_add_options --target=aarch64-apple-darwin
ac_add_options --without-wasm-sandboxed-libraries
ac_add_options --disable-debug-symbols
mk_add_options MOZ_MAKE_FLAGS="-j8"
export CBINDGEN=/Users/zeus/.codex/worktrees/firefox-158-port/cloakfox/firefox-src/.compat-tools/bin/cbindgen
export CC=/Users/zeus/.mozbuild/clang/bin/clang
export CXX=/Users/zeus/.mozbuild/clang/bin/clang++
export HOST_CC=/Users/zeus/.mozbuild/clang/bin/clang
export HOST_CXX=/Users/zeus/.mozbuild/clang/bin/clang++

ac_add_options --with-macos-sdk=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX26.5.sdk
